reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by 100, a numeric constant that is not in the Datadog source. The hard rules forbid this in promql; any unit scale must go in notes only.
postgresql.backends is a direct OTel equivalent of postgresql.connections (number of backends), so translating rather than blocking is correct.
Grouping by db maps to postgresql_database_name, which is observed in the dataset, so the grouping label is valid.
The metric is a non-monotonic sum, and avg by over it does not use rate(), so the aggregation shape is acceptable.
Template $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
